subject: Partner-led discovery / next steps — CloudBridge marketplace integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Partner discovery recap + next steps (demo / tech deep dive)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through CloudBridge's marketplace plans and the initial use cases you mentioned (partner discovery + marketplace listing flow). Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- What we heard: CloudBridge wants a hosted marketplace integration that supports private model listings, customer billing mapping, and a clear procurement path tied to marketplace SKUs.
- Primary success criteria: predictable latency for demo traffic, clear security/compliance handoff (SOC2 evidence + audit logs), and marketplace procurement support for your sales + finance teams.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Technical deep dive / integration demo with Mateo from our infra team — 60 minutes to cover auth, catalog mapping, and deployment options (hosted vs. private).
2) Procurement & commercial sync with Vanessa to align on marketplace listing process and revenue share model — 30 minutes.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 21 Jul, 10:00–11:00 or 13:00–14:00
- Wed 22 Jul, 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00

If those don't work, share a few slots and we'll align. I attached the preliminary requirements spreadsheet and our partner overview for your team to review ahead of the call.

Happy to include any other stakeholders from your side (product, procurement).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: CloudBridge-Prelim-Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood-Partner-Overview.pdf (presentation)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace@cloudbridge.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner discovery recap + next steps (demo / tech deep dive)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap — that matches what we discussed. We can do the technical deep dive on Wed 22 Jul 11:00–12:00 PST. I'll invite our product lead (Priya Rao) and procurement (procurement@cloudbridge.com) to the meeting.

A couple quick asks for the agenda:
- Can Mateo walk through the marketplace SKU mapping and how billing reconciliation would look?
- A short section on SSO / identity and whether you support SAML or OIDC for private deployments.

We plan to share our marketplace listing requirements and an initial procurement checklist before the call.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
alex.chen@cloudbridge.com

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner discovery recap + next steps (demo / tech deep dive)

Thanks all — looking forward to today's session. A couple technical notes I'll cover and want to confirm beforehand: 

1) Billing / SKU mapping: we'll demo a flow that maps marketplace SKUs to our internal product codes and shows how consumption is reported back to the marketplace (batch reconciliation). If CloudBridge needs real-time billing hooks, please flag that ahead of time.

2) Auth options: we support both SAML and OIDC for Redwood Private and can demo SAML metadata exchange during the call. If you have a test IdP, please share metadata or a contact for Priya.

3) Network & procurement constraints: for customers that prefer a private deployment, we'll outline VPC options and what evidence (SOC 2, audit logs) we can provide. Vanessa will cover the marketplace listing timeline and documentation requirements.

I've attached a short technical checklist I'll reference in the demo. If anyone wants to add items, put them in the shared doc before the meeting.

See you in ~45 minutes.

Mateo
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-Tech-Checklist.pdf
